en.title: More personal, less waiting
en.summary: Zona feels closer to home with your language, your sounds, and richer alerts.

items.title: English or Traditional Chinese
items.body: Choose the language that feels natural throughout the app.

items.title: Hear which PC needs you
items.body: Give each computer its own alert sound and recognize the source before looking.

items.title: See the whole story
items.body: Image attachments and Live Status put useful context where you can reach it quickly.

items.title: Less time watching loaders
items.body: Common account and inbox actions respond with less waiting.

zhHant.title: 更貼心，也少一點等待
zhHant.summary: Zona 現在支援你的語言、聲音和更豐富的提醒內容。

items.title: 英文或繁體中文
items.body: 在整個應用程式中選擇最自然的語言。

items.title: 用聲音分辨電腦
items.body: 為每部電腦選擇不同提示音，不用看螢幕也能認出來源。

items.title: 提醒內容更完整
items.body: 圖片附件和即時狀態讓重要資訊更容易看到。

items.title: 少看一點載入畫面
items.body: 常用的帳戶和收件箱操作現在回應更快。
